mechanism: A subscriber cancels at monthly renewal because essential spending leaves insufficient money to pay the subscription bill.
pressure_vector: Household cash shortage makes the bill unaffordable
failure_mode: Cancellation persists even when the bill is made affordable

mechanism: A subscriber cancels at monthly renewal because the finite project is finished and further subscription access provides no useful work.
pressure_vector: The completed task eliminates continuing demand
failure_mode: Cancellation persists among subscribers with substantial unfinished work
